add_export_config_cfg: add Caffe2 export configuration options to a detectron2 CfgNode config object
export_caffe2_model: export a detectron2 model to Caffe2 protobuf format using Caffe2Tracer
export_onnx_model: export a detectron2 model to ONNX format using Caffe2Tracer
Caffe2Tracer_export_torchscript: trace and export a detectron2 model to a TorchScript TracedModule
Caffe2Model_save_protobuf: save a Caffe2Model predict and init net as protobuf files to a directory
